desc: This ebony statuette, carved in the likeness of a horsefly, can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.dmgGiantFly00000]{Giant Fly} for up to 12 hours and can be ridden as a mount. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.
This item's limited uses represent the 2 days required before the figurine can be used again.
name: ebony fly
